input: What is the return window for Pro plan purchases?
contexts: Refund policy: Pro and Team plan purchases can be refunded within 30 days of the original charge. Free plan users are not charged and therefore have nothing to refund.
Enterprise contracts follow the terms in the signed order form and are handled by the account manager.
output: Pro plan purchases can be refunded within 30 days of the original charge.
expected: 30 days from the original charge for Pro and Team plans.

input: Does the API support pagination for the /orders endpoint?
contexts: GET /orders returns up to 100 results per page. Pass the `cursor` value from the previous response as `?cursor=` to fetch the next page. When `cursor` is null there are no more results.
Rate limits: 600 requests per minute per API key.
output: Yes. /orders returns up to 100 results per page and you page through using the cursor parameter from the previous response. It also supports filtering by date range.
expected: Yes, cursor-based pagination with up to 100 results per page.

input: How long does a data export take?
contexts: Data exports are generated asynchronously. Most exports finish within 15 minutes; workspaces over 50 GB can take up to 4 hours. You receive an email when the export is ready.
Exports are available for download for 7 days.
output: Most exports finish within 15 minutes, though very large workspaces (over 50 GB) may take up to 4 hours. You'll get an email when it's ready, and the download link stays valid for 7 days.
expected: Usually within 15 minutes; up to 4 hours for workspaces over 50 GB. Email notification when ready.

input: Can I use SSO on the Team plan?
contexts: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. Team and Pro plans support Google and GitHub OAuth login.
Two-factor authentication is available on all plans.
output: SAML SSO is only on Enterprise. On the Team plan you can sign in with Google or GitHub OAuth, and you can enable two-factor authentication.
expected: No, SAML SSO requires Enterprise. Team supports Google/GitHub OAuth.

input: What regions can I host my data in?
contexts: Workspaces can be provisioned in US (Virginia), EU (Frankfurt), or APAC (Sydney). Region is chosen at workspace creation and cannot be changed afterwards.
Backups are stored in the same region as the workspace.
output: You can choose US, EU or APAC when you create the workspace. You can migrate between regions later by contacting support.
expected: US (Virginia), EU (Frankfurt), APAC (Sydney), chosen at creation and fixed afterwards.

input: Is there a limit on team members?
contexts: Free: 1 member. Pro: up to 10 members. Team: up to 100 members. Enterprise: unlimited.
Guests can be invited to individual projects on Team and Enterprise without counting toward the seat limit.
output: It depends on the plan: Free has 1 seat, Pro up to 10, Team up to 100, and Enterprise is unlimited. On Team and Enterprise, project guests don't count against seats.
expected: Free 1, Pro 10, Team 100, Enterprise unlimited; guests are free on Team/Enterprise.

input: How do I rotate an API key?
contexts: Settings > API keys > Rotate. The old key keeps working for 24 hours after rotation so you can update your deployments, then it is revoked.
Keys are scoped to a workspace.
output: Go to Settings, then API keys, and click Rotate. The old key stays valid for 24 hours so you have time to update deployments.
expected: Settings > API keys > Rotate; the old key works for 24 more hours.

input: What happens to my data if I cancel?
contexts: After cancellation the workspace enters read-only mode for 30 days. During this time you can export data. After 30 days the workspace and all backups are permanently deleted.
You can reactivate a workspace during the read-only period by resubscribing.
output: Your workspace becomes read-only for 30 days so you can export everything. After that it is permanently deleted along with backups. Resubscribing within the 30 days reactivates it.
expected: Read-only for 30 days with export available, then permanently deleted; reactivation possible within 30 days.

contexts: Webhook deliveries that receive a non-2xx response are retried with exponential backoff: 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 12 h. After the fifth failure the event is dropped and the endpoint is marked unhealthy.
You can replay dropped events from the dashboard for 7 days.
output: Yes. Failed deliveries are retried five times with exponential backoff, up to 12 hours between attempts. After that the event is dropped, but you can replay it from the dashboard within 7 days.
expected: Yes, 5 retries with exponential backoff up to 12h; dropped events replayable for 7 days.

input: What's the maximum file upload size?
contexts: Individual files up to 250 MB can be uploaded through the web app. The API accepts files up to 5 GB using multipart upload.
Storage quotas: Pro 100 GB, Team 1 TB.
output: 250 MB through the web app, or 5 GB through the API with multipart upload.
expected: 250 MB via web app; 5 GB via API multipart upload.
